title: crypto2dev_main.c: module_init, module_exit, FIPS gate
description: The main module entry point orchestrates startup and shutdown in strict order, and is the first place wolfCrypt FIPS state is checked. module_init must: (1) call wolfCrypt_GetStatus_fips() and return -ENODEV if not OPERATIONAL, (2) call wolfkm_register_all(), (3) call wolfkm_cdev_init(), (4) pr_info with version, FIPS status, algorithm count. module_exit must call wolfkm_cdev_exit() then wolfkm_unregister_all(). Without wolfCrypt headers (WOLFKM_HAVE_WOLFCRYPT=0), stub mode emits pr_warn('wolfkm: STUB MODE — not for production').
design: MODULE_LICENSE(GPL v2), MODULE_AUTHOR(wolfSSL Inc.), MODULE_SOFTDEP(pre: wolfcrypt). Module param debug_level int default 0. Forward-declare wolfkm_register_all(), wolfkm_unregister_all(), wolfkm_cdev_init(), wolfkm_cdev_exit() so this file compiles with empty stubs elsewhere. See DESIGN.md §Module Initialization.
acceptance_criteria: Loads and unloads cleanly (insmod/rmmod) in stub mode. dmesg shows 'wolfkm: STUB MODE' warning. Module param debug_level visible in /sys/module/wolfkm/parameters/.
close_reason: Stale: from abandoned kernel-crypto-API-registration design. crypto2dev does not register into kernel crypto API (wolfcrypt.ko does that). Current implementation uses chardev+provider model instead.
